subject.title: 飞书话题群(Topic Group)被识别为p2p导致消息路由错误

question: Which Feishu discriminator should OpenClaw treat as authoritative for `chat_type: "p2p"` events from `oc_...` conversations?
rationale: Current source can reproduce the misroute, but the repository also has intentional direct-message-thread behavior for `p2p` plus `thread_id`, so automation should not choose the permanent classifier without maintainer intent.

options.title: Verify and land a narrow classifier
options.body: Treat only maintainer-verified Feishu topic-group evidence as group, then update inbound routing, mention-forward detection, and regression tests around both topic groups and true direct threads.

options.title: Adopt broader topic-anchor PR first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78964 as the product direction if maintainers want the larger anchor-preservation model to own this behavior.

options.title: Keep direct-thread semantics strict
options.body: Leave `p2p` events direct unless Feishu reports `topic_group`, accepting that this issue remains open until stronger live proof identifies a safe discriminator.

recommendation.title: Verify and land a narrow classifier
recommendation.body: Treat only maintainer-verified Feishu topic-group evidence as group, then update inbound routing, mention-forward detection, and regression tests around both topic groups and true direct threads.

likelyOwner.reason: Bartok has the current line-level history for the classifier/helper surface that maintainers would need to accept or change.
